obligations.behavior: noc_axi4_bridge_deser qualifies data capture with flit_in_go, clears stale payload words on each packet, and aligns beat k at data_out[64*k +: 64] so 1-beat NC stores appear at data_out[63:0].

noc_axi4_bridge_buffer gates deser_rdy with bram_rdy[fifo_in], arbitrates read_resp_val and write_resp_val work-conservingly with round-robin alternation, and aligns ser_header with ser_data in single-stage output registers.
obligations.enforced_by: private/tests/tb.sv, killed by wrong_fix_2, wrong_fix_3, mutant_08..mutant_10

obligations.behavior: noc_axi4_bridge_ser encodes MSG_LENGTH=0/1/8 based on request type and MSG_DATA_SIZE, latches inputs on in_go, and holds every flit (including the final payload beat) stable under flit_out_rdy==0.

Under BUILD.md, noc_axi4_bridge_deser maps to <= 4955.0 um^2, noc_axi4_bridge_ser to <= 4810.0 um^2, and noc_axi4_bridge_buffer to <= 21350.0 um^2, with >= 0.0 ns setup and hold slack at 1.08 ns clock.
